This article is a stub. Microplus is an Italian sports timing and data-processing company in Marene,
credited with the data processing at the 2014 European swimming championships, which
[ALGE-Timing](alge-timing.md) timed.

See the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers.
